user.title: Hallm Energy
user.description: Map the entities the integration reads and writes. Nothing is written until the shadow switch is off and the feature switch is on.

data_description.soc_entity: Sensor with the battery state of charge (%).
data_description.counter_entity: Total DC charge energy of the battery (kWh, only increases while charging).
data_description.counter_epoch: Change only when the counter is replaced or reset; a change blocks until resolved.
data_description.hdo_relay_entity: Measured tariff relay: on = off-peak now.
data_description.hdo_schedule_entity: Sensor with a `schedule` attribute (list of start, end and tariff NT or VT) and `last_update`.
data_description.grid_charge_entity: Inverter master switch for charging from the grid.
data_description.shadow_entity: Writes happen only while this is explicitly off.
data_description.feature_entity: Writes happen only while this is explicitly on.
data_description.slot1_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 1 (%).
data_description.slot2_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 2 (%).
data_description.slot3_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 3 (%).
data_description.slot4_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 4 (%).
data_description.slot5_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 5 (%).
data_description.slot6_capacity_entity: SOC floor and grid-charge target of slot 6 (%).
data_description.house_load_profile_topic: Retained MQTT topic with the house load profile snapshot. Without a usable profile PV is never credited and recovery is conservative.
data_description.topology_epoch: Profiles from another topology are rejected.
data_description.recovery_target_pct: Grid charging only up to this SOC; at least reserve + 5.
data_description.recovery_pv_wait_h: Anchored deadline for PV to restore the reserve before grid charging.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable DC capacity for SOC to energy conversion.
data_description.battery_efficiency: Charge and discharge efficiency for the simulation.
data_description.error_margin_morning_kwh: Extra energy PV must add on top of the reserve before waiting is accepted.
data_description.grid_charge_rate_dc_kw: Assumed rate for sizing the off-peak window.
data_description.budget_factor: Grant closes once usage reaches budget × factor (backup to the SOC stop).
data_description.pv_forecast_topic: Retained MQTT topic with the PV production forecast snapshot (correction already applied). Without a current one PV is never credited.
data_description.grid_relay_entity: Binary sensor that is on while the grid is present (e.g. the inverter's AC grid relay). Without it the integration assumes an island and never enters the morning exception.
data_description.enable_morning_dip: Activation gate: lets the battery fall to the morning dip floor before sunrise when PV is forecast to restore the reserve. Off by default.
data_description.outlook_margin_pct: Added to the reserve while the forecast of the next days does not cover the house (or cannot be judged).
data_description.outlook_days: Local days after today that the outlook covers (1-4).
data_description.morning_dip_floor_pct: Lowest floor inside the morning window; at most reserve - 5.
data_description.morning_dip_h: How long before the PV start the dip floor may apply.
data_description.refill_margin_min: Safety margin before the end of useful PV.
data_description.manage_floors: Activation gate: in live mode the integration keeps every slot floor at the planned value (raising always, lowering only with trustworthy inputs). Off by default; the planned floors are only reported.
data_description.audit_topic: MQTT topic for the audit events of grants and state changes. A receiver must acknowledge them on the same topic with /ack appended; events stay in a durable outbox until then. Without a topic delivery is paused and the events are kept.

error.invalid_mapping: Incomplete mapping, an entity used for two written roles, the same shadow and feature switch, a value out of range or a recovery target below reserve + 5.

provision.name: Provision
provision.description: Start trusting the configured charge counter (once, after verifying it measures DC charge energy).

safety_stop.name: Safety stop
safety_stop.description: Turn grid charging off now (live mode only); preempts any running sequence.

reprovision.name: Reprovision
reprovision.description: Trust the configured charge counter again after it was replaced, its epoch changed or the stored state was lost. Refused while a grant, step or episode is in flight; recorded in the audit.

discard_audit.name: Discard audit backlog
discard_audit.description: Remove every audit event that is still waiting for delivery. An explicit decision: switching the audit topic off only pauses delivery and keeps the events.
